svg.aria-label: Audio and camera -- sparse by construction. coupling derived from #include edges between libs/, port/ and src/; the number on an arrow is how many files carry it down: ra8_jpeg - to ra8_core (23), ra8_camera - to ra8_core (17), ra8_ov5640 - to ra8_core (4) ra8_audio - to ra8_core (3), ra8_camera - to ra8_hal (3), ra8_camera_io - to ra8_io (2), ra8_audio - to ra8_hal (1) in: ra8_jof - to ra8_jpeg (1) Two internal edges across five libraries, and that is the design working rather than a gap. ra8_ov5640 never includes ra8_camera and ra8_audio includes nothing here: both take their transport as a vtable in the config struct passed to *_init(), which is the project's Dependency-Inversion seam. Coupling that would show up as an #include is absent on purpose. Derivation: every arrow is an #include of a header owned by the target unit. CMake cannot answer this -- libs/*/CMakeLists.txt are no-ops and consumers glob libs/ lib to /src/*.c into one object library, so there are no target_link_libraries edges to read.

*_init(), which is the project's Dependency-Inversion seam. Coupling that would show up as an #include is absent on purpose.
